chunks: Just think: Who apart from God can show the way to him who deifies his ego into his god, whom God allows to go astray knowingly, and seals his ears and heart, and covers over his eyes with a veil? Why then do you not contemplate?
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when God seals the hearts and eyes of those who follow their desires?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the mechanism of divine punishment where God seals the faculties of those who voluntarily elevate their *hawa* (capricious desire) to the status of a deity, effectively blinding their intellect and perception. The 'sealing' is viewed not merely as a passive consequence but as a confirmation of their self-chosen spiritual stagnation, serving as a warning to believers to align their will with divine reason rather than ego. This concept underscores the Shia emphasis on *'aql* (intellect) as the faculty that must be purified from the distortions of desire to achieve true guidance.
